messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Segmentation fault when running GLAD
parts:
Hi,

I cannot tell what is going wrong, but my guess is that it can be
related to the following NEWS item of R v2.7.0:

SIGNIFICANT USER-VISIBLE CHANGES

o Packages which include graphics devices need to be re-installed
for this version of R, with recently updated versions.

Since you are using R v2.6.1, the Cairo package you've got installed
might be build for R v2.7.0 and not compatible with R v2.7.0.

So, you could test if you can load Cairo and use its PNG device to
generate a PNG file, or simply update to R v2.7.1.

Henrik
